purpose: Language-neutral public record and runtime-port authority for Bronze ingestion version 1.

type_expression_grammar.union: a key in unions; each union declares either a field discriminator or an explicit token_or_object form

canonicalization.text: UTF-8 with human-authored text already NFC
canonicalization.null: allowed only when the field declares nullable true
canonicalization.set_like_lists: reject duplicates then sort by canonical scalar bytes
canonicalization.integer_encoding: canonical base-10 string unless the field type is SafeInteger
canonicalization.derived_fields: fields marked digest_excluded are omitted only from the enclosing record's own derived-ID or content-digest basis; referenced records retain their declared digests
canonicalization.signature_fields: fields marked signature_excluded are omitted only from the enclosing signed-envelope bytes
